name: siw-electron
description: Electron desktop shell for Stock Intelligence Workstation (ADR 0028)

scripts.prepare-ui: cd ../desktop && corepack pnpm build && cd ../electron && node scripts/copy-ui.cjs
scripts.package: npm run prepare-ui && node scripts/write-config.cjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac --x64 --dir
scripts.dist: npm run prepare-ui && node scripts/write-config.cjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac --x64
